in_marathi.name: Raaju
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raaju हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Raaju is a combination of two words: Raja, meaning king or ruler, and U, which signifies protection and power. The name evokes a sense of strength, power, and leadership, reflecting the qualities of a true leader and protector.
